description: Read wiki pages in projects or groups. Actions: list (all pages with metadata), get (page content by slug). Related: manage_wiki to create/update/delete.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

slug.description: URL-encoded slug of the wiki page Required for 'get' action(s).

with_content.description: Include content of the wiki pages Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_wiki
